chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
If forgetfulness becomes frequent upon you, then leave it, for it will soon leave you. It is only from Shayṭān.

key_terms.السَّهْوُ: forgetfulness or distraction occurring during prayer
key_terms.الشَّيْطَانِ: Satan, the source of such disturbing insinuation
key_terms.فَدَعْهُ: leave it aside and do not act upon it
key_terms.يُوشِكُ: it is near or likely to happen soon

ai.seo_question: What should a person do when forgetfulness or distracting doubt becomes frequent in prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs the believer not to give attention to frequent forgetfulness or distracting doubt in salat. It teaches that persistent distraction should be ignored, as indulging it strengthens it, while disregarding it leads to its departure. The hadith also identifies such recurring disturbance as being from Shayṭān.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.989 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"If you experience frequent distraction (waswasah), ignore it, for it will soon leave you. It is only from Satan”.
